text:
Ivy (PM): Quick thread to finalize private preview selection + legal gating. Need a pragmatic rubric and a minimal privacy checklist.

Marco (GTM): We should score applicants on Impact (0-4), Readiness (0-4), Compliance sensitivity (0-2), and Willingness to commit personnel (0-2). Auto-filter by total >=6.

Harper (Legal): For compliance-heavy orgs, require a one-page data handling addendum. Also capture whether they need customer-managed KMS and on-prem install.

Zoe (Eng): Capacity note: we can run 6 full private stacks in parallel; reserve one sandbox. Recommend cohort size 6 starters max.

Luis (SE): Onboarding hours: assume 8h per org in week 0, 4h/week thereafter. If ops-risk flagged (on-prem), double the allocation.

Samira (CS): Incentives: offer a spotlight case study + $3k credit. Call out co-marketing as conditional on PR approval.

Ivy (PM): Proposal for screening flow: 1) form (5 mins + 2-min video upload), 2) automated score, 3) short follow-up call only for shortlisted. Keeps cycle quick.

Marco (GTM): Outreach snippet: "Pilot access + dedicated onboarding. Share a 2-min video of your current pipeline and one priority route."

Harper (Legal): Also add a clear telemetry consent checkbox: aggregated metrics OK, sampled outputs opt-in, raw customer logs only with explicit export consent.

Zoe (Eng): Baseline eval command for candidates: `redwood-eval --suite preview-baseline --routes sample.json --out baseline.json`. Make it a gating item before SE intro.

Luis (SE): Feedback cadence: first 2 weeks daily 30-min standups, then weekly 60-min working sessions. Weekly partner quickform (5 Qs) to capture blockers and asks.

Ivy (PM): Success criteria (draft):
- >=4 orgs reach "active" within 10 days of kickoff
- Median p95 per-route within SLO for 80% of routes
- At least 2 validated feature requests we can ship within the next quarter
- Pilot cohort satisfaction >= 6/10 at week 5

Samira (CS): Risk list: scope creep, legal hold requests, onboarding no-shows. Mitigations: OOS doc, AD consent template, mandatory eval run before scheduling.

Harper (Legal): Add a small clause for data subject rights - we won't retain sampled outputs beyond 30 days unless customer extends retention.

Marco (GTM): We should create a public-facing one-pager summary and an internal playbook. I'll draft outreach + cohort spreadsheet.

Zoe (Eng): I'll add telemetry opt-out flags to the onboarding repo and a simple rollback runbook for bad deployments.

Luis (SE): Onboarding checklist (gates): account connect, eval run passed, SE intro, perf dashboard access, production route smoke test.

Ivy (PM): Action items:
- Marco: outreach copy + cohort sheet by EOD Thursday
- Zoe: eval CLI + rollback doc by Friday
- Luis: onboarding checklist + SE hour plan by Friday
- Harper: data addendum + retention clause by Friday
- Samira: incentive copy + co-marketing guardrails by Friday

invite-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2240012380 (ping #product)

Marco (GTM): I'll post the outreach draft here when ready.

Ivy (PM): Thanks team 44d Will aim to start invites next Tuesday.
